categories.main_business_segments: MIDAC Holdings operates three main business segments: waste disposal (including intermediate and final treatment of industrial and general waste), waste collection and transportation, and intermediary management services (connecting waste generators with disposal companies and managing related administrative tasks). The group is structured as a pure holding company with several consolidated subsidiaries handling these operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes a range of waste treatment technologies, including dehydration, incineration, neutralization, and crushing for intermediate processing, as well as landfill operations for final disposal. Facilities are equipped to handle hazardous, flammable, and corrosive wastes, with certifications for special management industrial waste. The group also employs advanced sorting, mixing, and recycling preparation methods, and maintains strict compliance with environmental regulations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: MIDAC Holdings primarily serves business operators generating industrial and general waste, including manufacturers, construction companies, and local governments. The company also provides intermediary services to other waste disposal firms, facilitating connections between waste generators and processors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Japan, particularly in the Tokai region (Shizuoka, Aichi, Gifu, and Mie prefectures), with facilities and subsidiaries also covering parts of the Kanto region and some expansion into eastern Japan. There are no overseas operations or sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: MIDAC Holdings operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the waste management supply chain, handling collection, intermediate processing, and final disposal of waste. The company also acts as an intermediary, connecting upstream waste generators with downstream disposal solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding its integrated waste management capabilities, investing in new treatment and landfill facilities, and pursuing M&A to broaden its regional footprint, especially in high-demand areas like Kanto. Sustainability, compliance, and decarbonization are emphasized, with targets for CO2 reduction and ongoing initiatives in renewable energy and recycling. There is no significant in-house R&D; innovation is pursued through operational improvements and facility investments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees for waste collection, intermediate and final disposal, and intermediary management services. Pricing is typically based on waste volume, type, and transportation distance, with contracts directly with waste generators or through intermediary arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a competitive Japanese waste management industry, facing both established regional players and new entrants from other sectors. MIDAC Holdings differentiates itself through its integrated, full-service model and strong compliance record, positioning itself as a leading comprehensive waste management provider in its core regions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 10.9 billion yen, with operating profit of 4.5 billion yen and net profit of 2.86 billion yen. The company has demonstrated robust growth, with sales and profits increasing year-over-year (sales up 14.2%, net profit up 50.1%), and maintains a strong balance sheet with over 15.4 billion yen in net assets and 28.5 billion yen in total assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MIDAC Holdings emphasizes its ability to provide safe, reliable, and fully compliant waste management solutions, covering the entire process from collection to final disposal. Its integrated service model, broad range of treatment capabilities (including hazardous waste), and strong regional presence offer customers a one-stop solution with high environmental and regulatory standards, supporting the transition to a circular and sustainable society.
